items.name: Spirit Pull

items.name: Explosive Blade

items.name: Defender

items.name: Deep Strikes

items.name: Samurai Unleashed

items.name: Lightning Reflexes

items.name: Critical Defense

items.name: Resolve Increase

items.name: Heavenly Strikes

items.name: Staggering Arrow
items.guide: Shoots an arrow that stuns enemies within a small area.

items.name: Explosive Arrow

items.name: Executioner
items.guide: Boosts headshot damage by 50% against targets within 12 meters.

items.name: Scent of Blood
items.guide: After an assassination attempt, doubles draw and reload speed for 30 seconds.

items.name: Hunter Unleashed
items.guide: Reduces class ability cooldown by 15%.

items.name: Resupply

items.name: Piercing Arrow

items.name: Healing Incense

items.name: Enhanced Ghost Weapons

items.name: Weakening Burst

items.name: Ronin Unleashed
items.guide: Reduces class ability cooldowns by 15%.

items.name: Staggering Imposition

items.name: Resolve Increase

items.name: Quick Regen

items.guide: Reduces class ability cooldowns by 15%.

legends_story_missions.description: 2-player co-op story missions told by the storyteller Gyozen, building toward the final antagonist Iyo. Each mission is split into 3 stages (torii gates), each with its own bonus side objectives. There are 9 story missions total, confirmed in order via the game's own mission-select screen (cross-checked against ghostoftsushima.fandom.com and gamepressure.com walkthroughs). The file previously had these out of order, with 3 slots marked unconfirmed, and wrongly listed 'The Tale of Iyo' as mission 9 — that's actually the separate 3-chapter endgame Raid (tracked under legends_raid_tale_of_iyo), not one of the 9 story missions.

legends_survival.description: 4-player horde mode defending a location against escalating waves of Mongols and Oni. Difficulty raises the enemy count, recommended Ki, and reward Ki.

items.name: Gold
items.guide: Any Ghost death fails the mission.

items.name: Platinum
items.guide: Any Ghost death fails the mission.

items.name: Nightmare
items.guide: Any Ghost death fails the mission. Weekly rotating modifier.

legends_rivals_maps.description: 4-player (2v2) competitive PvP mode, added later as a free update alongside Gear Mastery.

legends_raid_tale_of_iyo.region: Legends Mode (Multiplayer) - 4 players, min Ki 100, no matchmaking
legends_raid_tale_of_iyo.description: The endgame Raid, the culmination of the Legends story. Requires a full team of 4 Ghosts, no matchmaking (friends only), and a minimum recommended Ki level of 100. Trials of Iyo - a bite-sized, harder-difficulty version of the Raid with its own leaderboards, added with the Director's Cut update.

trophies.name: Promising Start
trophies.description: Complete a Legends Mode story mission.

trophies.name: Ultimate Truth
trophies.description: Complete the final wave in a Gold Survival run.

trophies.name: Transcendence
trophies.description: Complete all 3 Raid (Tale of Iyo) chapters.

class_rank.description: Each class levels independently from 1 up by earning XP in missions. Rank-ups grant skill points to spend on that class's skill tree (perks above) and unlock the next class ability. Ranks of note: 1 (first class ability), 10 (second class ability), and perk unlocks at ranks 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 14, 16, and 18 (Legendary item slot).
class_rank.trophy_goal: Ultimate Warrior trophy: reach Rank 20 with all 4 classes.

ki_level.description: Your gear power level (Ki) is the average item level of your equipped Katana, Ranged weapon, Charm, and 2 Ghost Weapons. Raised by equipping higher-level gear found from missions, not by XP directly.
ki_level.gear_mastery_note: Gear Mastery (added Aug 2021) lets a Level 110 item be pushed to Level 120 by completing 5 Mastery Challenges per item (each adds +2 levels, costs 2000 Essence to activate).

reference.legends_class_unlock_order_note: Your first class is free. Additional classes unlock as your overall player level rises: a 3rd class around Rank 15, the 4th and final class around Rank 22. Exact order of which 2nd/3rd class unlocks can vary.

story_legend_of_the_ghost.description: Jin's single-player leveling system (separate from Legends mode's class ranks). Gained through story progress, liberating areas, and combat. Each rank gives Technique Points for the Samurai/Ghost/Stance skill trees plus passive bonuses (max health, Resolve, new Ghost Weapons).
story_legend_of_the_ghost.note: Sources differ on whether there are 1-2 additional intermediate ranks between Wandering Samurai and Shadow Samurai (named variously 'The People's Hope' or 'The Unyielding Wind' depending on game version). Exact XP thresholds aren't reliably documented.

reference.story_side_content_note: Side quests (Tales of Tsushima), Mythic Tales, and collectibles (Mongol Artifacts, Hot Springs, Haiku, Inari Shrines, etc.) aren't broken out yet since the story hasn't been started - ask and this can be filled in once you're further along.
